entries.subject: pty-throughput
entries.title: Terminal output into the window
entries.passMark: No lost bytes, echo under 100 ms, memory under 300 MB
entries.summary: No terminal output is dropped and typing echoes with no noticeable delay; memory during heavy bursts missed the original limit.

measured.label: Bytes received
measured.value: Full payload in every pane, plus a 1 to 7 byte surplus whose source is not identified; never a deficit

measured.label: Peak memory
measured.value: 492 MB at 256 KiB high-water; 789 MB at 1 MiB

entries.subject: libghostty-vt
entries.title: Terminal snapshots from Ghostty’s engine
entries.passMark: Clean cargo build under 5 minutes on a clean runner, and a plain-text vim snapshot that matches
entries.summary: Ghostty's engine builds within its time budget and captures a vim screen snapshot that matches what was typed.

measured.label: Clean build
measured.value: 42 s on macOS 27 with Homebrew zig@0.15

measured.label: Vim snapshot
measured.value: First line equals the typed text

entries.subject: reviewer-readonly-codex

entries.summary: A read-only Codex probe is stopped by the operating system when it tries to change a file, and says so.

measured.label: target.txt after the probe
measured.value: Unchanged; blocked by the OS sandbox

entries.subject: pty-memory
entries.title: Terminal memory limits
entries.passMark: Idle under 150 MB, and burst peak under 600 MB at the 1 MiB high-water mark, in the real TerminalPort
entries.summary: Will check that the real terminal stays within new memory limits, both at rest and during heavy output.

entries.subject: local-worker-gpt-oss
entries.title: A local 120B model as a third worker
entries.passMark: Answers a warm prompt within 30 s and finds the known defect in a real review, within 10 minutes
entries.summary: Through Codex the model ran out of GPU memory on every request; called directly it answered but missed the real defect.

measured.label: Through Codex
measured.value: No answer at 131k or 40k context; Metal out of memory

measured.label: Direct Ollama call, 8k context
measured.value: 2,758 prompt tokens, 113.5 s, missed the defect, 2 of 4 findings false

measured.label: Cloud Codex, same review
measured.value: Found the defect twice, in 29 s and 100 s

entries.subject: crew-harness
entries.title: A test bench for agent crews
entries.passMark: Every harness behaviour is proven by a test that failed first, and the typecheck is clean
entries.summary: It checks crew setups, gives each task its own copy of the code, stops runaway loops and compares crews with one agent.

measured.label: Real preflight
measured.value: Codex and Ollama answered; stopped on the revoked Claude login, as designed

entries.subject: m0-foundation
entries.title: Stack and interface foundation
entries.passMark: The three stack spikes have results, and the kbui adoption and app theme in bezl #1 and #3 are merged with their checks passing
entries.summary: The stack experiments have results and the task screen runs on kbui 0.4.0, but it is not merged yet.

measured.label: Stack spikes
measured.value: Terminal output partial, snapshots pass, Codex read-only pass

measured.label: Task screen
measured.value: 37 unit and 62 browser tests pass on kbui 0.4.0, in bezl #3

entries.subject: m1-crew-test
entries.title: Crew test
entries.passMark: 4 of 5 tasks green with only a merge from the operator, no cap or loop stops, crew tokens at most twice one agent alone, and at least one real defect caught in review
entries.summary: Will test whether a writer and a reviewer coordinated by Bezl beat one agent working alone.

entries.subject: m2-domain-core
entries.title: The core task rules
entries.passMark: Tests cover the writer lease, every state transition and rebuilding a task from its log, and a second writer on a worktree is refused
entries.summary: Will build the task rules in Rust: one writer per copy of the code, and a log that is only ever added to.

entries.subject: m3-providers
entries.title: Which assistants are ready
entries.passMark: The Providers screen shows real preflight results for every installed CLI, every provider Bezl offers has a read-only probe result, and spikes/03-reviewer-readonly is deleted with its findings in docs/spikes
entries.summary: Will show which assistants are installed and signed in, and how far each can be trusted.

entries.subject: m4-live-terminals
entries.title: Live terminals
entries.passMark: Three panes stream 20 MB each with no lost bytes, idle memory under 150 MB and bursts under 600 MB, and spikes 1 and 2 are deleted, including spike_pty.rs and src/spike, with their findings in docs/spikes
entries.summary: Will stream real agent sessions into Task panels within the memory limits.

entries.subject: m5-first-task
entries.title: A first real task, start to finish
entries.passMark: A real task finishes with a writer and a read-only reviewer, one approval is answered in the app, and the evidence screen shows every event and snapshot
entries.summary: Will take a real task through every screen, from setup to approval and evidence.

entries.subject: m6-crew-in-bezl
entries.title: Crews inside Bezl
entries.passMark: The five crew-test tasks, run inside Bezl, match or beat the harness results on every threshold, and spikes 4 and 5 are deleted with their findings in docs/spikes
entries.summary: Will build crews into Bezl, if the crew test passes.

entries.subject: m7-preview-canvas
entries.title: An interactive preview canvas
entries.passMark: A UI task's takes appear as artboards within 30 seconds of a step finishing; a pointed change and a drawn change each land in the right file; a recorded four-step flow replays on two takes and catches a seeded focus bug in one of them, then runs as a saved test; and a seeded contrast failure shows on Check with its evidence
entries.summary: Will let people use, point at, draw on, record and compare live previews of every take.

entries.subject: m8-explore
entries.title: Design directions from several models
entries.passMark: On five UI tasks, building from a chosen direction needs fewer review rounds than building straight from the brief
entries.summary: Will let several models sketch design directions before any code is written.

entries.subject: m0-foundation
entries.title: Stack and interface foundation
entries.passMark: The three stack spikes have results, and the kbui adoption and app theme in bezl #1 and #3 are merged with their checks passing
entries.summary: kbui with the app theme is merged and passes its checks on main; the Claude reviewer probe runs under M3.

measured.label: Stack spikes
measured.value: Terminal output partial, snapshots pass, Codex read-only pass

measured.label: Checks on main at 20f28ca
measured.value: bun run check exit 0: typecheck, Biome, 53 unit and 74 browser tests

entries.subject: e1-evidence-engine
entries.title: Evidence engine
entries.passMark: On 10 real agent branches, at least 3 real problems the agent called done and at most 1 false alarm per branch, labelled blind; the four buckets add up on a Go and a TypeScript repository; every run lists its degradations
entries.summary: Will show whether Bezl's evidence catches real problems in agent work that the agent called done.

entries.subject: m1-crew-test
entries.title: Crew test
entries.passMark: In one writer direction, cross-provider review beats the matched-budget writer and same-provider review on hidden-test pass rate (paired 95% interval above zero) at no more than twice the tokens; verified findings have precision of at least 0.5
entries.summary: Redesigned: a review-only phase, then the full loop with hidden tests, in both writer directions.

entries.subject: m2-domain-core
entries.title: Domain core
entries.passMark: Tests cover the writer lease, every state transition and rebuilding a task from its log; a second writer is refused; the four buckets always add up; no test writes a tracked file
entries.summary: Will build the task rules in Rust, keep records in .git/bezl and adopt the evidence engine's contracts.

entries.subject: m3-providers
entries.title: Providers and preflight
entries.passMark: Real preflight results for every installed CLI, a read-only result for every provider offered, contract tests passing against pinned CLI versions, and spike 3 deleted
entries.summary: Will show which agent CLIs are installed and signed in, which reviewers cannot write, and what each reports.

entries.subject: m4-live-terminals
entries.title: Live terminals
entries.passMark: Three panes stream 20 MB each with no lost bytes, idle memory under 150 MB and bursts under 600 MB at the 1 MiB high-water mark, and spikes 1 and 2 deleted
entries.summary: Will stream real agent sessions into the app without losing bytes, within the memory limits.

entries.subject: m5-first-task
entries.title: First real task, end to end
entries.passMark: A real task finishes with a writer and a read-only reviewer, the operator answers one question in the app, Check shows the evidence engine's result, and the history shows every event and snapshot
entries.summary: Will take a real task from brief to pull request in the app, with evidence on Check.

entries.subject: m6-crew-in-bezl
entries.title: Crew in Bezl
entries.passMark: If M1 passed, its Phase 2 tasks run in Bezl match or beat the harness on every threshold; otherwise three real tasks complete with a handover and a model switch, with every finding reaching the operator
entries.summary: Will add takes, model switching and handover; automatic findings to the writer only if the crew test passes.

entries.subject: m7-preview-canvas
entries.title: Preview canvas
entries.summary: Split into M7a, M7b and M7c, each tracked under its own subject from now on.

entries.subject: m7a-recorded-flows
entries.title: Recorded flows as evidence
entries.passMark: A recorded four-step flow catches a seeded focus bug and runs as a saved test, a seeded contrast failure shows on Check, and a project with no working run command reports could not run
entries.summary: Will turn recorded flows and accessibility checks on a live preview into checks that run after every step.

entries.subject: m7b-point-draw
entries.title: Point and Draw
entries.passMark: A pointed change and a drawn change each land in the right file on a real project, and a mark stays on its element when the preview is resized
entries.summary: Will let people point at or draw on the running app to say what to change.

entries.subject: m7c-multi-take-canvas
entries.title: The multi-take canvas
entries.passMark: Takes appear as artboards within 30 seconds of a step finishing, and a recorded flow replays on two takes and catches a seeded bug in one
entries.summary: Will show every take side by side on one board, with replay and compare.

entries.subject: m8-explore
entries.title: Explore with several models
entries.passMark: On five UI tasks, building from a chosen direction needs fewer review rounds than building straight from the brief
entries.summary: Frozen until the crew test shows that a design step before coding helps.

entries.passMark: The write is refused and the refusal shows in the output
